cohort: Eight pregnant women hospitalized with COVID-19 who received casirivimab and imdevimab therapy were compared to ten pregnant women hospitalized with COVID-19 who did not receive the therapy.
finding: Maternal administration of casirivimab and imdevimab was safe with no apparent adverse events, and it led to a rapid improvement in fever within 24 hours.
followup_time: Initial neonatal findings for babies; 48 hours post-administration for mothers.
